inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person (all tiers)
inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle, a licensed, English-speaking Egyptologist guide, and one bottle of mineral water per person are included in every tier.

The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to all three sites and the Philae boat transfer); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: Entry to all three sites (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)

inclusions.text: Philae boat transfer (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)
inclusions.source: Three tiers (Base / + Entrance Fees / + Entrance Fees & Lunch); the bundled tier includes the Philae motorboat.

inclusions.text: Midday meal (Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tier only)
inclusions.source: The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to all three sites and the Philae boat transfer); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: Transfer back to your Aswan hotel
inclusions.source: The boat returns you to the mainland, and a vehicle transfer brings the day to a close back at your Aswan hotel.

exclusions.text: Entrance fees kept separate from the Base fare
exclusions.source: Egyptian entrance fees are revised often, so keeping them separate keeps the base fare honest.
